notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. Sources: 2018_00_link (HR Faculty Medical Leave Guidelines); 2018_01 CBA 2017-2021; 2018_02 HR AAUP parental page; 2018_03 HR AAUP maternity page; 2018_04 By-Laws (rev. 2017-03-29); 2018_05 HR tenure-clock procedure.

Governing documents in force: the UConn-AAUP collective bargaining agreement 2017-2021 (covers Professor, Associate and Assistant Professor; excludes faculty of Medicine, Dental Medicine and Law) with Appendix B Faculty Medical Leave Guidelines, and the By-Laws approved 2017-03-29. The HR leave-type pages are summaries (undated, captured October 2017) and cite the 2007 contract's numbering (Art. 13.7, 19.IV.I, 24.2, 26.1) and By-Laws XIV.C.4 and XIV.L.4.

No paid parental leave: the CBA family leave (19.6.I) is unpaid, up to six months, with the University paying individual health insurance. The birth parent's paid time is the maternity (medically certified disability) period, generally 6 weeks (8 after a Caesarean), paid under the Faculty Medical Leave Guidelines (V1b, the UConn example in the rule).

Birth parent chain: maternity leave c2 (6-8 weeks, paid, within the Guidelines' paid medical leave c3) → CBA unpaid family leave c1 (up to 6 months); FMLA c7 alongside from the birth (concurrent_with c2, c3, c1); C.G.S. 46a-60 pregnancy-disability leave c9 alongside c2; C.G.S. 5-248a c8 alongside c1. Medical leave beyond the disability: c3 then the discretionary unpaid extension c4, capped at 2 years continuous (leave_limits).
Non-birth parent chain: CBA unpaid family leave c1 (up to 6 months) from the birth, with FMLA c7 and C.G.S. 5-248a c8 alongside; own sick leave may pay family FMLA (c6, within c7).

U8: the Guidelines' paid medical leave steps up with service; the two-year member is in the under-three-years band (six months paid, extension unpaid and discretionary). Longer bands add discretionary paid extensions (in c3 duration_note).

The SEBAC 2017 clause (CBA 19.6.I last paragraph) lets members use sick leave time to pay for family FMLA 'provided that change is made so that additional unpaid leave is not tacked on the end of FMLA leave'; its effect on the six-month family leave is not stated (flagged on c6). Tenure-stream faculty's sick-leave balances are not described in any source (By-Laws XIV.L.4: each case considered separately).

Cited but not saved: SEBAC 2017 Agreement; voluntary leave program 'as constituted between the parties in 1994' (CBA 19.6.J; terms unknown, not coded); Voluntary Schedule Reduction Program (CBA 19.10.B); C.G.S. 5-248a, 5-196(20), 46a-60(a)(7); Pregnancy Discrimination Act; Statewide Family and Medical Leave Policy; 'Understanding Family and Medical Leave (A primer for Connecticut State Employees)'; CBA child-care reimbursement guidelines (19.6.H); Provost's Guidelines on Promotion, Tenure, and Reappointment.

Not components: CBA 19.6.H child-care reimbursement pool ($160,000 a year; not leave, pay for absence, relief or protection); sabbatical leave (By-Laws XIV.L.1; for advancement of knowledge, not usable for a birth); military leave; CBA 16.7 union release.

Calendar: the documents state a semester calendar (fall and spring semesters) without a length → calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component is measured in semesters.
School of Medicine provisions (c13) are recorded with faculty_group naming the school (V3b); the Health Center faculty are outside the AAUP unit.

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
